{{Top|leg}}
'''Grom 2''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Assassin-class corvette]], which together with its sister ship, ''[[Grom 1]]'', accompanied the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaught]] ''[[Anat]]'' on its [[Battle near the Blair Cluster|ill-fated final trip near the Blair cluster]]. Upon being pulled from hyperspace by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] police action in the form of Star Destroyer [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] and Interdictor ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'', ''Grom 2'' was ordered to engage. It met its end at the hand of Imperial torpedoes along with ''Grom 1'' and, soon after, ''Anat''.
